(365)brgyud gsum rig 'jin skong ba tshangs pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/hūm̐:nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams na:ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'

tei:div.tei:p: brgyud gsum rig 'jin skong ba tshangs pa'i dbyangs zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ hūm̐: nang gsal gzhon nu bum sku'i zhing khams na: ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rje'i bdag nyid can: khyad chos drug ldan dbyings su sangs rgyas pa: chos sku kun bzang yab yum thugs dam bskang : lhun grub nges pa lnga ldan zhing khams na: mtshan rdzogs dpe byad yon tan 'bar ba'i dpyid: kha sbyor bde chen yan lag bdun gyi dngos: longs sku rigs lnga'i sangs rgyas thugs dam bskang : rigs brgya rigs lnga gsang chen rdo rje 'jin: rgyal kun thugs mchog ye shes snying po can: 'bum phrag drug cu'i bka' yi bsdu ba mjad: sprul sku rdo rje sems dpa'i thugs dam bskang : dga' ldan brtsegs par tshe lo dpag med dus: rang snang sprul pa'i sangs rgyas stong rtsal: thal 'gyur rtsa rgyud chos kyi 'khor lo bskor: khye'u snang ba dam pa'i thugs dmam bskang : mi mjed 'jig (366)rten che lo bye ba'i dus: mkha' 'gro'i 'khor la bstan pa sku gsung thugs: yon tan phrin las rgyud kyi chos 'khor bskor: ston pa 'og min 'khrugs pa'i thugs dam bskang : drod gshod 'dus par tshe lo 'bum pa'i dus: sems dpa'i 'khor la rgyud gsum gsang ba tshe: zur phud gsum pa'i skad kyis chos 'khor bskor: ston pa 'jam dpal 'jigs skyob: thugs dam bskang : chags 'byung mngal snang tshe lo brgyad khri'i dus: gnod sbyin 'khor la bstan pa rgyud lnga dang : yan lag rgyud drug chos ston gzhon nu rol: rnam par rtse ba ston pa'i thugs dam bskang : 'tsho byed lhum rar tshe lo bdun khri'i dus: rab bdun 'khor la phar phyin drug la sogs: zhi ba bsil ba'i chos char 'bebs mjad pa: drug pa rdo rje 'chang chen thugs dam bskang*/ me ri 'bar bar tshe lo drug khri'i dus: sprin gyi shugs 'chang sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la: pha ma (367)bla med rgyud kyi chos ston pa:

gzhon nu dpa' bo stobs ldan thugs dam bskang*/ ru lu'i sgra ldan tshe lo khri pa'i dus: srin po'i rig 'jin bye ba phrag gcig la: rags pa 'dul ba'i rgyud bcu'i chos 'khor bskor: drang srong khros pa'i rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : bya rgod phung por tshe lo lnga snyong dus: rdzu 'phrul ldan pa'i nyan thos 'khor rnams la: dam chos 'dul ba dpag tu med pa gsungs/ dgra bcom gser 'od dam pa'i thugs dam bskang : g.yu yi smin gnas tshe lo stong gi dus: par gnas 'khor la 'phra rgyud bdun la sogs: zab pa zhi ba'i chos kyis tshim mjad pa: brtse bas rol 'i blo gros thugs dam bskang : bya rgod spungs par tshe lo lnga brgya'i dus: khams gsum dgra bcom 'phags pa'i 'khor rnams la: mdo sngags zung 'jug chos kyi 'khor lo bskakor: ston pa 'od srung bsgres po'i thugs dam (368)bskang*/ byang chub 'byung ba tshe lo sum brgya'i dus: rigs gsum mgon po sprul pa'i 'khor tshogs la: nges pa don gyi snying po'i chos char 'bebs: ston pa mngon rdzogs rgyal po'i thugs dam bskang : zas sbyin ra bar tshe lo brgya pa'i dus: rnam bzhi'i 'khor la bden bzhi'i chos 'khor bskor: 'gro rnams yang dag lam du drangs mjad pa: ston pa shākya thub pa'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ḥ bskang ngo skal pa'i thugs dam bskang : rig 'jin brda brgyud thugs dam bskang : sprul pa chen po'i thugs dam bskang : bskang bas dngos grub bdag la stsol: mgon po ston pa bcom ldan 'dasaḥ dga' rab rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : dpal ldan ye shes dkyil 'khor can: 'jam dpal bshes gnyen thugs dam bskang : sku gsum ye shes lnga dang ldan: shrī seng ha'i thugs dam bskang : ye shes rtsal rjogs de bzhin gshegs: ye shes mdo yi (369)thugs dam bskang : 'od kyi lus can rjogs sangs rgyas: bi ma mi tra'i thugs dam bskang : khams gsum zil gnon he ru ka:

rdo rje thod phreng thugs dam bskang : hūm̐ bskang ngo bskal pa'i thugs dam bskang : snyan brgyud bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : rig 'jin gdung 'tshob thugs dam bskang ཿ bskang bas dngos grub bdag la stsol: mkha' 'gro 'bar ba'i sprin 'phro ba: ye shes mtsho rgyal thugs dam bskang : dngos grub mchog brnyes 'od sku 'grub: ting 'jin bzang po'i thugs dam bskang : bar dor grol ba'i gdeng thob pa: ldang ma lhun rgyal thugs dam bskang : zag pa rang zad 'od kyi sku: seng ge dbang phyug thugs dam bskang : chos zad gdod ma'i grub mtha' snyogs: rgyal ba zhang ston thugs dam bskang : lag na rdo rje sgyu 'phrul 'chang : mkhas pa nyi 'bum thugs dam bskang : lhun (370)grub snang bzhi mthar son pa/ gu ru jo 'ber thugs dam bskang : chos brgyad 'khrul pa dbyings su zhig: seng ge rgyab ba'i thugs dam bskang : brtul zhugs grub pa'i 'gro ba 'dul: me long rdo rje'i thugs dam bskang : sku gsum las gyi snang bar rjogs: ku ma rā ja'i thugs dam bskang : zab mo'i gter gyi sgo 'byed pa: las 'brel rtsal gyi thugs dam bskang : snang srid sku dang zhing khams rjogs: klong chen rab 'byams thugs dam bskang : rgyal kun spyi gzugs mkhyen brtse'i gter: 'jigs med gling pa'i thugs dmam bskang : nang gsal dbyings su rtsal rjogs pa: rgyal ba'i myu gu'i thugs dam bskang : chos kyi dbang phyug chos kyi rgyal: chos kyi dbang po'i thugs dam bskang : lta sgom spyod pa mthar phyin pas: sa mchog dkyil 'khor chen por grub: bstan pa'i nyi ma'i thugs dam bskang : (371)rig 'jin gdung 'tshob 'gro ba'i mgon: ngag gi dbang po chos kyi rje: rtsa ba'i bla ma'i thugs dam bskang : hūm̐: dbyings sprul smug nag ral gcig ma: rdzu 'phrul nam mkha'imatha' dang mnyam: srid pa ma mo'i 'khor dang bcas: e ka ja ṭi'i thugs dam bskang : dug lnga 'khrugs pa'i da la nas:

ak+ṣa dz+wa ma rung pa: gza' brgyad gdong bzhi rgyu skar bcas: khyab 'jug chen po'i thugs dam bskang : gsod byed lha mo shan pa'i gtso: srog gcod sde bzhi'i dmag dpung dang : srid pa'i bdag mo ma mor bcas: srog sgrub nag mo'i thugs dam bskang : gling bzhi'i srid pa'i dkyil 'khor nas: phung byed dmar nag mthu rtsal can: gdong mo bzhi dang bcas pa yi: shan pa dmar nag thugs dam bskang : yang gcig thugs dam bskang ba (372)ni: gtsang btsan 'bar ba mchod 'khor bcas: zhing skyong lha mo lcam dral dang : tshe ring mched lnga brtan mar bcas: sman btsun rdo rje g.yu sgron sogs: brgyud gsum bla ma'i spyan snga ru: gsang chen rdzogs pa chen po yi: bstan pa skyong bar khas blangs pa'i: dam can rgya mtsho'i thugs dam bskang : rnal 'byor bdag gi mi shes pas: sdom gsum dam tshig nyams pa bshags: ma 'ongs sgrib par mi 'gyur ba'i: tshangs pa mchog gi dngos grub stsol: zhes yig brgya brjod/ ces pa 'di ni kun mkhyen chen po'i byin brlabs kyi snang ba snying la 'bar ba'i theg pa mchog gi rnal 'byor pa 'od gsal rin chen snying po las 'brel rtsal gyis bris pa re zhig dge'o/// /
